newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Columbia/HCA rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Columbia/HCA rated buy.

text.p: -- Hilliard Lyons analyst Stephen O'Neil said Monday he raised his rating on Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp to buy from hold following a recent decline in the stock price.

-- In a report, he attributed the weakness to a federal investigation in Columbia/HCA's El Paso, Texas, market. The company has said its management and employees in its El Paso facilities cooperated with federal authorities.
-- The analyst said he believes the current share price sufficiently discounts for uncertainty surrounding the probe.
